name: Medieval Studies - BA
narrative: The Medieval Studies major consists of at least 48 total units, at least 36 of which must be upper-division, with courses accounting for the breadth requirements listed below. All courses to be applied to the major must be completed on a letter grade basis. The advisors for the major are the Executive Director and the Faculty Chair of the Medieval Studies Program.

MAJOR REGULATIONSPREREQUISITES Check the General Catalog for the prerequisites to all listed courses.
P/NP GRADING OPTION Not allowed for major courses (prep or UD), including courses applied to the major from other departments.
SUBSTITUTIONS In the major requirements permissible only by petition to the department chair and dean.
G.P.A REQUIREMENTS At least 2.0 overall UC average in all upper-division major courses and all courses (Prep and UD) for the major.
DOUBLE MAJORS With the approval of each department chairperson, up to a total of 8 units may be applied simultaneously to both UD majors.
